title: PhD Position in Process Simulation and Techno-Economic Optimization of Large-Scale Power-to-X Systems
description:
The Center for Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position focusing on process simulation, techno-economic assessment, and optimization of large-scale Power-to-X (PtX) systems for the production of renewable fuels and chemicals. The preferred start date is February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Job Description

The PhD position is part of SDU Life Cycle Engineering's research activities on PtX technologies, renewable fuel production, sector coupling, and the transition toward climate-neutral energy systems.

PtX technologies are expected to play an important role in decarbonizing hard-to-abate sectors by converting renewable electricity into synthetic fuels, and chemicals. However, their large-scale deployment requires efficient process design, effective integration with local energy system and biomass availability, and economically competitive operation under variable renewable electricity supply and changing market conditions.

The PhD project aims to develop and apply advanced process simulation and techno-economic optimization frameworks for large-scale PtX systems. A central focus will be on linking detailed process simulations with techno-economic models to evaluate alternative process configurations, identify opportunities for sector coupling, and optimize technology capacities and operating conditions. The project will also investigate how electricity prices, renewable electricity availability, hydrogen, biogas and CO2 supply, and process flexibility influence the economic performance of industrial-scale PtX facilities. The research will combine process simulation tools, particularly Aspen Plus, with computational modelling and optimization approaches. 

The successful candidate will contribute to ongoing national and international research projects and collaborate with academic and industrial partners working on PtX technologies and sustainable energy systems.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering (SDU LCE) at the University of Southern Denmark's main campus in Odense. 

SDU LCE is a rapidly expanding research center with a strong international profile in net-zero transitions and sustainable energy systems. The center conducts research on integrated energy system design, renewable energy integration, PtX technologies, carbon management, sustainable biomass utilization, sector coupling, and CCUS integration.

SDU LCE is actively engaged in national and international research projects supported by the EU, national innovation programs, private companies, and other organizations.

Within SDU LCE, the research group focusing on renewable fuel production, process integration, techno-economic assessment, and energy system optimization is experiencing significant growth. The group combines detailed process modelling with system-level analysis to address the technological and economic challenges associated with industrial decarbonization.

For more information about SDU LCE, please visit www.sdu.dk/lifecycle. 

 

Qualifications

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate with a master’s degree in chemical engineering. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in process modelling, thermodynamic analysis, techno-economic assessment, and optimization of renewable energy conversion technologies. Experience in the following areas will be considered an advantage: 

  • Process simulation using Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or similar software.

  • Modelling of Power-to-X technologies.

  • Thermodynamic modelling, mass and energy balances, process design, and heat integration.

  • Techno-economic assessment, including capital and operating cost estimation, levelized production costs, and economic sensitivity analysis.

  • Programming and numerical optimization using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.

  • Understanding of renewable electricity integration, process flexibility, and sector coupling.

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, an independent and curious research mindset, and an interest in interdisciplinary collaboration. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills are required.

 

Responsibilities

The successful PhD candidate will be expected to: 

  • Develop detailed process simulation models of selected large-scale Power-to-X technologies and integrated production pathways.

  • Perform thermodynamic analysis, mass and energy balances, and process integration assessments.

  • Develop techno-economic models to estimate investment costs, operating costs, and levelized production costs of renewable fuels and chemicals.

  • Apply optimization approaches to investigate process configurations, operating conditions, technology capacities, and economic performance.

  • Evaluate the impacts of electricity prices, renewable energy availability, and feedstock supply on PtX system design and operation.

  • Identify opportunities for improving energy efficiency, heat recovery, resource utilization, and process flexibility.

  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners involved in the research.

  • Complete the required PhD courses (30 ECTS) and undertake a research stay abroad.

  • Publish research findings in high-impact scientific journals and present results at international conferences.

  • Prepare and successfully defend a PhD thesis based on the research conducted.

 

About the team

The PhD fellow will work in the SDU Life Cycle Engineering (SDU LCE) center at the Department of Green Technology. The main supervisor will be Associate Professor Hossein Nami and co-supervision will be provided by Professor Henrik Wenzel.

 

Further information 

For further information regarding the position, please contact Associate Professor Hossein Nami at tel.: +45 52751924, email: hon@igt.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • 1-page application letter including a statement of motivation.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • List of publications and maximum 3 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Part-time Bartender til Tamashii
description:
I November åbner Norrlyst Koncernen dørene til Tamashii - et nyt ambitiøst restaurantprojekt på en af Københavns mest unikke lokationer

Tamashii betyder “sjæl” på japansk, og køkkenet bliver moderne asiatisk med Henrik Jyrks personlige aftryk. Ambitionen er høj, med teknik og råvarekvalitet i den skarpe ende, men uden den formalitet, der ofte forbindes med fine dining.

Fra køkken og service til vinkort og indretning er Tamashii skabt med en ambition om at nå Michelin-niveau.

Om Norrlyst Koncernen

Norrlyst Koncernen står bag nogle af Københavns mest markante restauranter og vinbarer. Fælles for vores steder er en kompromisløs tilgang til kvalitet, stærkt værtskab og et ønske om at skabe oplevelser, der både føles professionelle og personlige.

Vi tror på, at gode baroplevelser skabes af mennesker, der elsker faget. Derfor giver vi plads til udvikling, ansvar og engagement – og vi værdsætter både faglighed og god energi højt i vores teams.

Rollen

Stillingen er på deltid/on-call.

Du arbejder i et miljø med højt tempo og høje standarder, hvor du er med til at sikre, at gæsterne får en oplevelse, der er både effektiv, nærværende og velfungerende.

Du laver cocktails, serverer vin og drikkevarer og er samtidig med til at skabe den stemning, som gør baren til et sted, gæsterne har lyst til at blive hængende.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring som bartender – gerne fra en travl og ambitiøs bar eller restaurant.

  • Har solid forståelse for cocktails, spiritus og/eller vin.

  • Trives i et højt tempo og bevarer overblikket i service.

  • Er udadvendt, imødekommende og god til at skabe kontakt til gæster.

  • Er en holdspiller, der bidrager til god energi bag baren.

  • Har lyst til at udvikle dine færdigheder og blive endnu skarpere i faget.

Vi tilbyder

  • En plads i en ny og ambitiøs bar i hjertet af København.

  • En hverdag med højt tempo, stærkt fællesskab og dygtige kolleger.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling inden for bar, cocktails og service.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet, energi og godt samarbejde.

  • Attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår.

  • Personalefordele på tværs af Norrlyst Koncernens restauranter og vinbarer.

Hvis du elsker faget, trives i et levende miljø og vil være en del af en bar med ambitioner, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

title: Experienced Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a Project Manager with experience in Horizon Europe project management, public consultations and event facilitation to support three key areas:

  1. Large-scale research project implementation within SDU NAT's External Relations Team and the Department of Biology

  2. Coordinate SDU NATs contribution to public consultations and other science-to-policy activities 

  3. Facilitate public representation of SDU NAT and the Departments under the faculty, at key events

You will be responsible for operational and administrative management across projects involving Danish and European research institutions.

The successful candidate hold a PhD in marine biology or a closely related marine science discipline and bring hands-on experience in EU Missions projects, combining project coordination with research-based reporting and stakeholder engagement to maximise the impact and uptake of project outcomes.

Your ProfileThe ideal candidate has a research background in marine science, experience from public authorities and with mission-based projects. The candidate should be comfortable bridging operations with research, supporting deliverables, monitoring progress, and translating complex data into clear insights for partners, funders, educators, and diverse stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities

Project and operational management:

  • Implement and take responsibility for the operational management of the projects and research 

  • Support leadership and act as an administrative contact for stakeholders at SDU, with a special focus on public authorities 

  • Liaise with funding agencies, SDU administrative staff, and external partners. And ensure processes align with SDU rules and funder requirements

  • Assist in internal and external communications. Support, facilitate and coordinate organising events, workshops, public engagement activities and meetings

  • Prepare scientific, impact and financial reports

  • Document project progress and ensure timely submission to funders

  • Coordinate data collection and information sharing among partners

  • Coordinate stakeholder and community engagement activities across partner organisations, including industry, authority and scientific partners

  • Contribute to policy analysis and impact evaluation to strengthen societal relevance and uptake of project results, particularly within ocean and water contexts

Required Qualifications

  • A PhD in marine science, environmental science, or another relevant natural science discipline

  • Experience in project coordination and research management, including planning of research cruises, within universities, research institutions, public authorities or consultancies

  • Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English and Danish 

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and meet strict deadlines

  • High attention to detail and organisational skills

  • Familiarity with administrative tools such as WorkZone

  • Demonstrated experience applying data analysis and reporting skills 

  • Working with Horizon Europe funding schemes

  • Experience from public authorities, and implementing workflows and administrative systems in university settings

Desirable Experience

  • Organising cross institutional participation in large public and policy events 

  • Experience with EU Mission-aligned environmental/ocean projects and international consortia coordination, including deliverables, timelines, and compliance processes

  • Experience supporting cross-institutional collaboration and helping build an active community around education

You have a research background (PhD) in natural sciences (preferably marine biology, oceanography, biology or environmental science) and experience from Danish and other European research institutions and/or public authorities. You are enthusiastic, a team player, supportive and highly flexible to meet the variety of work. Due to the specificity of the projects and funding programmes, with strict application deadlines, and “last-minute projects” there are peak periods where you must be able and willing to work longer hours.

We offer:We offer a motivating and exciting position with ample potential for personal development at the Faculty of Science at SDU, a faculty characterized by ambition, commitment and an informal and flexible working environment. You will also work locally in close collaboration with strong scientific environments. You will become part of the External Relations Team that bridges project management, policy intelligence, liaison with funders, capacity building, leadership support with hands on grant writing. SDU offers a full time permanent position, an attractive work-life balance, a competitive salary* with the option for qualification allowance, frequent trainings and personal development.

We strongly encourage European experts to apply for these positions. SDU and the Region of Southern Denmark provides excellent repatriation services, language courses, day-care and international schools, and a strong and growing international community. 

The External Relations Team is part of the Dean’s office with around 50 colleagues and study-administration, communication and finance teams. The science faculty consists of four Departments: Biology, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Mathematics and Computer Science, and Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy. The faculty hosts 500 employees and 2000 students.

Contact Head of External Relations Team Mikkel Girke Jørgensen (m: +4565502330; mikkelj@sdu.dk) for more information.Expected Start Date: 1 January 2027 or soon after

Application, salary etc.Salary and employment conditions are related to educational background and applicable collective agreements between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

To be considered for this position, please fill out an online profile and attach the following documents:

  • Cover letter 

  • Resume (CV) including information on previous employment with start and end dates 

  • Certificates, and if possible, a list of up to three references. 

All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDUThe University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Ergoterapeut søges til vikariat i Gentofte Kommune
description:
FIRMAVIKAR søger en ergoterapeut til et spændende vikariat i Gentofte Kommune med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Der er tale om et vikariat på ca. 2 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse eller fastansættelse.

På vegne af vores kunde søger vi en engageret og ansvarsbevidst ergoterapeut, der har lyst til at arbejde med neurorehabilitering og gøre en forskel for borgere med behov for genoptræning og støtte i hverdagen.

Du bliver en del af et eksisterende tværfagligt team, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger arbejder med at styrke borgernes funktionsevne, selvstændighed og livskvalitet.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Ergoterapeutisk vurdering og behandling af borgere.

  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af individuelle rehabiliteringsforløb.

  • Arbejde med neurorehabilitering.

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med øvrige sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere.

  • Dokumentation og opfølgning på borgernes udvikling.

  • Øvrige ergoterapeutiske opgaver i den daglige drift.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring med rehabilitering, gerne inden for neurorehabilitering.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og indgå i et tværfagligt team.

  • Har gode kommunikationsevner og kan skabe tryghed for borgerne.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, mødestabil og fagligt engageret.

  • Taler og skriver dansk.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et spændende og alsidigt vikariat i Gentofte Kommune.

  • Et fagligt miljø med fokus på neurorehabilitering.

  • Samarbejde med erfarne kolleger og andre faggrupper.

  • Mulighed for forlængelse eller fastansættelse.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Gentofte KommuneAntal stillinger: 1Opstart: Hurtigst muligtVarighed: Ca. 2 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse eller fastansættelseArbejdstid: Mandag til fredag i tidsrummet kl. 08.00–16.00Ansættelsesform: Vikariat, forventeligt fuldtid

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte os på 93 93 81 81.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker at finde den rette kandidat hurtigst muligt.

title: Epidemiologist for Strategy Consultancy in Copenhagen
description:
ReD’s scientific portfolio is growing rapidly. We are seeking a new hire with epidemiological training to work closely with the Partners and Science Director to deliver and expand our work with our philanthropic, life science, and pharmaceutical clients.   

Work will include delivering the next phase of The Vaccine Trust Project. Through this work, we apply our trust framework and measurement tools to vaccination research and implementation. We work with worldwide partners to design studies, analyze data, and translate findings into actionable recommendations that can increase vaccine uptake.  Candidates should also be interested in the wider work at ReD - and how their skills could complement what we do. 

The wider science portfolio includes advising leading research and scientific organizations, conducting evidence synthesis, and supporting clients publishing across a range of formats. The successful candidate will contribute to all these activities and will have opportunities to shape the work according to their skills and interests.  

The ideal candidate will be confident and experienced with the core epidemiological toolkit. They will be interested in developing innovative methods and applying them creatively to new contexts. Their work will have a direct impact on some of the biggest global challenges. The successful candidate will have significant opportunities for mentorship alongside professional development in both science and consultancy.  

The role is Copenhagen based. 

The Process:Candidates should submit their CV and a short (1-2 pages) cover letter. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview with the Science Director. This will be followed by a culture and fit interview with the COO. From this, a small pool of candidates will be invited for a Partner Interview before a final decision is made.   

Core Skills

Candidates will have some relevant experience in the listed fields, for example they may hold a relevant MSc or have recently completed a PhD.  Core skills include:

  • Applying core epidemiological methods to research datasets, including, for example, descriptive statistics, regression, and psychometric analysis. 

  • The design and interpretation of observational studies and clinical trials. 

  • Cleaning and managing data to ensure it is suitable for epidemiological analysis. 

  • Writing and implementing statistical analysis plans. 

  • Conducting statistical analyses in R (or language that they could rapidly transfer). 

Desirable Skills

We are seeking candidates who are interested in learning and developing on the job. Some desirable skills in addition to the core skills listed above include: 

  • Experience working in low- and middle-income country contexts. 

  • Experience with monitoring and evaluation. 

  • Strong evidence synthesis skills, such as conducting systematic reviews. 

  • Experience with mixed-methods research. 

  • A record of academic publication. 

  • Demonstrated scientific writing, grant writing, and presentation abilities. 

About ReD Associates

ReD Associates help organisations grow and transform by creating original strategies based on human behaviour. Since 2005, ReD has helped leaders to unlock growth by applying a deep understanding of people and culture to complex problems at the core of their business. We understand people by understanding their worlds. Our curiosity, rigorous methodology, and bespoke approach to strategy is guided by the anthropologists, sociologists, economists, scientists, journalists, and designers who make up our team. We are based in Copenhagen, New York, Paris, and the Bay Area.

title: Postdoc Positions within Mobile Robotics at SDU Robotics
description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within mobile robotics. We therefore invite applications for one or more postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to the mobile robotics lab specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automated agriculture as well as related applications that require mobility in open terrain. We expect that the research activities involve both computer vision for scene understanding, tracking of relevant artefacts, as well as the integration and development of AI-based solutions for autonomous operation in scenarios within, e.g., field processing. The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in testing facilities at SDU as well as project partners and head the evaluation efforts in collaboration with a consortium of interdisciplinary project partners. 

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching and supervision responsibilities could also be part of employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Participation in ongoing and future research projects.

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to mobile robots controlled with multimodal feedback. The candidates are hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge with ROS2 and relevant modules such as the Nav2

  • Strong knowledge in multi-object tracking

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design, development and integration of robotic systems

Furthermore, the successful candidates are expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

Research environment

The candidates will be integrated in the unit SDU Robotics. We are a team of approximately 60 researchers and engineers based in Odense. We actively work across traditional disciplinary boundaries to develop new technologies and scientific knowledge. Our research contributes to novel solutions with applications in welfare, industrial automation, lab automation, and healthcare. Furthermore, the unit has a long-standing tradition of collaboration with industrial partners.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics.

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international working environment with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher within the field of robotics. 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Associate Professor Leon Bodenhagen lebo@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Verified copies of official certificates/diplomas and transcripts of exams (MSc and PhD), both the original documents and in professional English translation.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position, may also be included. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

Employment terms

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

This postdoc position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

title: Software Engineer for Centre for Software Technology (CST)
description:
Centre for Software Technology (CST), part of the Software Engineering units at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, located in Vejle, invites applications for an engineering position to support the buildup of the Centre and supporting laboratories. The centre is a newly started center that focuses on software engineering, interaction technology and AI research and education in close cooperation with companies to utilize the potential in digitalization. It is expected that the centre will experience a significant growth over the next five years.

The Centre for Software Technology (CST) at SDU is a part of the new campus, SDU Vejle, home of excellence within information technology. The academic focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is to conduct research in interactive information technology and software engineering. The areas will be complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The centre is involved in a variety of research and collaboration projects nationally and internationally. The centre has a strong collaboration with industry to solve challenging research problems from real applications, and to participate in implementing the achieved results into real solutions with end users. The work in the centre is structured around a number of laboratories.

The work and responsibilities for the applicant will be within the areas of:

  • Prototyping interactive technologies such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, circuits, microcontrollers, soldering, sensors, and actuators

  • Software development in relation to advanced interaction technologies, intelligent systems, cyber-physical systems, e.g. in the areas of critical infrastructure and healthcare systems

  • Developing and maintaining infrastructures to support the laboratories in close collaboration with the associated researchers

  • Support for research and educational activities

  • Managing lab space including inventory, supplies and materials, space maintenance and organization, developing and enforcing safety procedures, providing and managing training for specialized fabrication equipment

  • Digital/physical fabrication with laser cutters, 3D printers, 3D modeling, making enclosures for interactive electronics, making professional robust physical artifacts

  • Facilitating and participation in business development in collaboration with local industry and municipality

  • Using AI technologies effectively, ethically and systematically in the context of engineering applications 

The applicant we are looking for should have one or more of the following competencies:

  • Experience with collaboration projects that involve industry and academia

  • Experience with implementing software solutions in a variety of programming languages

  • Experience with managing a lab space including managing training for specialized fabrication equipment.

  • Experience with prototyping interactive technologies and digital/physical fabrication

  • Experience with software development processes and methods

  • Experience with infrastructures to support software development (e.g. Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud infrastructures)

  • Experience with the development of middleware, services, micro services, and databases

  • Experience with Generative AI and Prompt Engineering, e.g. tailoring effective prompts to instruct LLMs; knowing the dos and don’ts of GenAI from ethical angles 

  • Experience with data engineering including the use of machine learning frameworks with software such as PyTorch and TensorFlow

It is expected that the candidate has documented qualifications related to the position, for example, shown by a degree in the field of software engineering, interaction technologies, computer engineering, computer science or similar or previous related job positions.

A candidate should be able to achieve a Danish security clearance to take part in the development of critical technology.

We offer a dynamic and diverse work environment with a large variety of tasks, and you will be given the opportunity to work on different research projects applying your skills within the software domain. It is expected that you can work in a team, but also solve your tasks independently.

Further information is available from LEGO® Chair and Professor Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard, mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk, +45 2197 2447.

Application deadline is November 22, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).  

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary and employment terms

The position is available from January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The position is full-time. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Runner søges til Restaurant Sukiaba på toppen af det ikoniske Bella Sky
description:
Har du lyst til at blive en del af et ambitiøst restaurantteam, hvor godt værtskab, samarbejde og sans for detaljen er i centrum?

På toppen af det ikoniske Bella Sky finder du Restaurant Sukaiba – en del af Norrlyst-koncernen og et sted, hvor udsigt, atmosfære og asiatisk inspireret gastronomi forenes i en helt særlig gæsteoplevelse.

Sukaiba byder på både en ambitiøs restaurant og en cocktailbar, hvor japansk finesse møder nordisk præcision. Vores drikkeprogram forener vin, sake og cocktails i nøje sammensatte pairing-oplevelser, og vores store vinkort understøtter ambitionen om at skabe en helstøbt oplevelse for hver eneste gæst.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

Vi søger dig, der

Om dig

Du har drive, tager naturligt ansvar og trives med at være en vigtig del af holdet bag en vellykket service. Du forstår, at de små detaljer gør en stor forskel, og du møder både gæster og kolleger med overskud, respekt og et smil.

Vi søger både deltids- og fuldtidsrunnere.

title: Postdoctoral position in breast cancer epidemiology / clinical epidemiology
description:
The Department of Clinical Epidemiology at Faculty of Health at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as postdoctoral research fellow in the field of Breast Cancer Epidemiology as per 15 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. This is a two-year position is fully funded by the Health Insurance Denmark.The Department of Clinical Epidemiology is a research department at Aarhus University Hospital, within the Institute of Clinical Medicine at Aarhus University. Researchers in the department use advanced epidemiological methods to study the prognosis of patient populations. The department is engaged in a variety of activities regarding clinical epidemiological research, including cancer prognosis research. The department is involved in counselling health care professionals to improve the quality of health care and treatment. A large number of projects in the department are carried out in cooperation with Danish and international collaborators.About the research projectThe position entails research within clinical epidemiology, specifically within breast cancer and breast cancer survivorship. The successful candidate will join a project focusing on studies related to adherence to breast cancer treatment; side effects and complications of breast cancer and its treatment; and how these may influence quality of life, long-term survivorship, and early and late breast cancer recurrence. The project investigates the association of pharmacological, genetic and socioeconomic factors and adherence to cancer treatment; employing advanced epidemiological methods including emulated target trials, group-based trajectory modelling, mediation analyses, and Bayesian modelling approaches to investigate adherence to cancer treatment and recurrence. The research fellow will join a vibrant and dynamic multinational and multidisciplinary project team (the Predictors of Breast Cancer Recurrence – ProBeCaRe – project team) with established successful long-term research collaboration. The successful applicant will contribute to the development of the department through research of high international quality. They will work closely with colleagues, receiving supervision and guidance. Emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s interest in building bridges between clinical, epidemiological and biostatistical research.The main tasks will consist of:
  • Research in clinical epidemiology, specifically within breast cancer and breast cancer survivorship.
  • Make applications as needed for access to Danish population-based and medical registries.
  • Independently perform statistical analysis using programmes such as R, SAS, or equivalent.
  • Collaborate within an active research group with national and international collaborators.
  • Contribute to teaching at the Aarhus University and its collaborators, as necessary.
  • Take part in grant writing and participate actively in research fundraising.
  • Gain experience supervising students.
  • Conduct independent research of high international quality, including publication.
  • Write scientific articles and participate in international congresses.
  • Perform other tasks within the Department of Clinical Epidemiology fields of interest. Please see our webpage at www.kea.au.dk.
Your competencesYou have academic qualifications at PhD/DSc level preferably within one or more of the following areas: epidemiology, clinical epidemiology, cancer epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, and/or can document familiarity with epidemiological research at an international level. Research experience in cancer and pharmacologic research would be advantageous, but not essential. Research experience in epidemiologic methods, analysing and incorporating data from Danish registries, including data from the National Clinical Quality Cancer Databases (specifically data from the Danish Breast Cancer Group), the Health Services Register, and the National Patient Registry, would be useful, particularly data incorporating socioeconomic factors. Research experience in cancer survivorship, patient reported outcomes and national surveys would be a benefit as well. Evidence of the ability to secure competitive research grants would be advantageous. As a person, you are motivated, ambitious, take ownership and possess good communication and interpersonal skills. We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English, with good knowledge of Danish.In order to be assessed as qualified for this position, you must meet these academic criteria.Shortlisting will be used.Principal supervisorDeirdre Cronin Fenton, PhD, ProfessorPhone: +45-87168209 / E-mail: dc@clin.au.dkDepartment of Clinical Epidemiology, Clinical Institute, Aarhus University, Olof Palmes Alle 43-45, 8200 Aarhus N.Questions about the positionIf you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Deirdre Cronin Fenton tel.: (+45) 8716 8209 or dc@clin.au.dk.Your place of work will be the Department of Clinical Epidemiology, Olof Palmes Alle 43-45, DK-8200 Aarhus N, Denmark.Terms of employment
  • Appointment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.
  • Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.
  • The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).
  • Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.
  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime postdoc is between DKK 493.394,35 and DKK 585.322,48 depending on the years of working experience after achieved MSc degree. The base salary includes a position related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplemement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.
  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.
  • Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff
ApplicationYour application must include the following:
  • Motivated application
  • Curriculum Vitae
  • Diploma
  • Template for applicant - postdoc
  • A list of publications
  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios
  • A maximum of five of the publications of greatest relevance to the job may be submitted (optional)
  • Research plan can be uploaded (optional)
  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)
  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)
We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.International applicant?Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here. Aarhus University also has a Junior Researcher Association and offers career development support. You can read more about these resources here.The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Injektionsoperatør
employer: Hammer Coating v/ Rasmus Hammer Sørensen
description:
Vi søger en injektionsoperatør til specialiseret betonrenovering

Hammer Coating søger en medarbejder til injektionsarbejde på Nyt Hospital Nordsjælland i Hillerød.

Har du hænderne skruet rigtigt på, er du fysisk stærk og har du lyst til at arbejde med specialiseret betonrenovering? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Hos Hammer Coating arbejder vi med specialiserede løsninger inden for renovering, tætning og reparation af beton. Vi udfører blandt andet injektion i revner, støbeskel, elementsamlinger og andre utætheder i betonkonstruktioner.

Lige nu søger vi en medarbejder til en opgave på Nyt Hospital Nordsjælland i Hillerød, hvor arbejdet blandt andet består i at banke flydespartel op for at blotlægge revner, som efterfølgende skal injiceres.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Ophugning af flydespartel og klargøring af betonoverflader.

  • Klargøring og udførelse af injektionsarbejde.

  • Reparation og tætning af revner, støbeskel og elementsamlinger.

  • Arbejde med forskellige materialer, herunder epoxy, polyurethan og cementbaserede produkter.

  • Brug af håndværktøj og teknisk udstyr til betonrenovering.

Arbejdet varierer fra opgave til opgave, og du bliver en del af et fagområde, hvor kvalitet, præcision og forståelse for materialerne er afgørende.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er i god fysisk form og trives med praktisk og fysisk arbejde.

  • Har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og gerne erfaring fra byggebranchen.

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og grundig med dit arbejde.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også fungerer godt sammen med kolleger.

  • Har fokus på at udføre arbejdet ordentligt og passe på kroppen.

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at have erfaring med injektion. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at lære et specialiseret håndværk.

Et fysisk arbejde med fokus på et langt arbejdsliv

Arbejdet kan være fysisk krævende, og det er vigtigt, at du har fysikken til opgaverne. Samtidig lægger vi vægt på at arbejde fornuftigt, bruge det rigtige udstyr og passe på kroppen, så vi kan holde til faget i mange år.

Hvem er Hammer Coating?

Hammer Coating udfører specialiseret betonrenovering og tætning. Vi arbejder med løsninger, hvor almindelige metoder ikke altid er tilstrækkelige, og hvor den rigtige teknik og det rigtige materiale gør forskellen.

Hos os får du mulighed for at lære et specialiseret fag med mange forskellige typer opgaver og gode muligheder for at udvikle dine håndværksmæssige kompetencer.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send en kort ansøgning eller ring for en uforpligtende snak.

Hammer CoatingE-mail: post@hammercoating.dkHjemmeside: www.hammercoating.dk

title: Nyoprettet stilling som afdelingsleder af Bostøtte og forebyggende indsatser
description:
Kan du lede i tillidsfulde relationer og fortsat skabe mulighed for, at en gruppe dygtige medarbejdere kan udfolde deres faglighed til gavn for Albertslunds sårbare borgere? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Vi har besluttet at styrke ledelsen tættest på medarbejderne i forbindelse med organisationsændring på voksensocialområdet. Vi søger derfor den rette kandidat til nyoprettet lederstilling. 

 

Albertslund er en grøn kommune med store ambitioner. Vi er stolte af vores kommune, og gør os umage i vores opgaver og indsatser for borgerne, foreningerne og virksomhederne. Vi er én kommune og én organisation. Vi har engagerede og dygtige medarbejdere samt en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer. Det gør Albertslund Kommune til et godt sted at arbejde. 

 

Om os

Vi har netop gennemført en organisationsændring, og vores enhed er så ny, at vi endnu ikke har valgt et navn, men vi består af Bostøttekorspet, Hjulet og Transit – i alt 26 medarbejdere. Overordnet set har vi lille medarbejderudskiftning og trives med at arbejde selvstændigt.

                          

Bostøttekorpset er organiseret i tre teams. Vi tilbyder bostøtte, SEL §85, til borgere i egen bolig. Vi støtter borgere med udfordringer bredt inden for det specialiserede voksenområde.

I Bostøttekorpset er kommunens tre opsøgende støttekontaktpersoner, SEL §99, ligesom vi varetager Housing First indsatser, SEL §85a, både i egen lejlighed, men også i kommunens seks hjemløseboliger.

Hjulet er et lille selvstændigt bostøttekorps, som varetager bostøtte hos ti unge borgere med autismespektrumforstyrrelser.  Borgerne bor i fem sammenhængende gårdhavehuse, hvoraf det ene er fællesområde. Bostøtteindsatsen i Hjulet dækker hele døgnet.

Transit er vores forebyggende indsatser efter SEL §§82 a og b. Transit tilbyder individuelle forløb og gruppetilbud i vores aktivitetstilbud Villa Social. De individuelle forløb kan også foregå i egen bolig.

Der er stor tilgang til alle vores indsatser.

 

Vi har et meget tæt samarbejde med sagsbehandlerne i Socialenheden for Voksne, da vi er kommunens primære leverandør af individuelle støtteindsatser. Vi har netop gennemført et uddannelsesforløb i Recoveryorienteret rehabilitering sammen med Socialenheden for voksne og områdets klubtilbud.

 

Stillingen

Du vil få personaleansvar for enhedens medarbejdere og vil have ansvar for at skabe gode rammer og bringe medarbejdernes evner i spil. Du vil videreudvikle de rette rammer for vores interne kommunikation, sparring, møder, supervision mm.

Du vil sammen med områdelederen sætte retning og skabe sammenhæng og helhed i enhedens indsatser.

Som leder lægger vi vægt på, at du har fokus på trivsel og opbakning samt bidrager til et arbejdsmiljø, der understøtter vores selvledelse.

 

Du vil have ansvar for at sikre kvaliteten i indsatserne, faglig udvikling, samt at ressourcerne anvendes bedst muligt i forhold til borgernes behov. Du vil bl.a. kunne følge dette, da du vil være en del af visitationsudvalget. En af de tætteste samarbejdspartnere er lederen af Socialenheden for voksne. I vil sammen skulle sikre at viden fra uddannelsesforløb i Recoveryorienteret rehabilitering implementeres i praksis. Ligeledes vil I arbejde sammen om at videreudvikle Housing first indsatserne og de forebyggende indsatser i Transit

I Hjulet vil du skulle understøtte, at borgere med tiden flytter ud i egen bolig og nye kommer til.  

 

Du vil referere til områdelederen og arbejde tæt sammen med tre andre afdelingsledere på at udvikle vores nye område. Vi har bl.a. fået til opgave at styrke samarbejdet om borgere med sociale udfordringer på tværs af ældre-, sundheds-, social- og beskæftigelsesområdet. 

 

Forventninger til dig

  • Har erfaring med arbejdet med områdets målgrupper og indsatser
  • Har erfaring med ledelse af medarbejdere og gerne ledelse på afstand
  • Har lederuddannelse eller ønsker at efteruddanne dig
  • Kan omsætte strategier og målsætninger til handlinger
  • Besidder troværdighed, ordentlighed, ansvarlighed
  • Er tillidsvækkende, inddrager og kan skabe følgeskab
  • Er åben, initiativrig og dialogsøgende
  • Kan se værdien i tværfagligt samarbejde og aktivt arbejder for at sikre relationer på tværs af organisationen.
  • Er nysgerrig og har mod, men er også empatisk og rummelig
  • Kan passe på dig selv og andre
  • Har en positiv tankegang og er fleksibel

 

 

Det praktiske

Stillingen ønskes besat pr.1.januar 2027 og er på 37 timer.

Arbejdssted er Stationstorvet 12., 2. sal., 2620 Albertslund.

 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du ringe til områdeleder Berit Berrig på 26377871

 

Ansøgningsfrist fredag den 20.november 2026 kl.: 11.00

Der afholdes 1. samtale den 23. november og 2. samtale den 27. november

 

Lønindplacering sker efter forhandling mellem kommunen og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.Det er en del af Albertslund Kommunes ansættelsespolitik at fremme mangfoldighed og ligestilling.Det er en forudsætning for din ansættelse i Albertslund Kommune, at du har en gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse, samt at der kan fremvises tilfredsstillende straffeattest.

Albertslund Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

 

Velkommen til Albertslund - den bæredygtige by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskaber. Albertslund Kommune har mange kvaliteter, som skaber fantastiske rammer for hverdagslivet – både for borgere og medarbejdere. Midt i naturen og med et rigt forenings- og kulturliv, som børn og voksne cykler til og fra på byens mange kilometer cykelstier, der er adskilt fra bilerne på vejene. Der er S-tog lige til døren og flere supercykelstier, bl.a. mellem Albertslund og Vesterport i hjertet af København. Desuden skaber også letbanen gode forbindelser til hele hovedstadsområdet.

I Albertslund Kommune har vi samme tilgang til vores opgaver, som vi selv ville ønske at opleve som borgere. Vi er vidt forskellige, men er fælles om vores opgave for borgere, foreninger og virksomheder. Du kan møde nogle af vores dygtige medarbejdere på www.albertslund.dk/indefra og få et indtryk af bredden af arbejdsområder, opgaver og fagligheder i Albertslund Kommune. 

I Albertslund Kommune er der højt til loftet og gode udviklingsmuligheder - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant
description:
Are you passionate about Embedded Linux and eager to make a real impact across industries? Join Prevas as an Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant, helping our clients navigate technology transitions, ensure product security, and build new embedded solutions for a safer, smarter world. Whether you come from a consultancy background or have experience as a technical leader in product development, this could be your next step.

About the Role: Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

As part of our team, you will collaborate with a wide variety of organizations – from global enterprises to innovative startups. Your main focus will be on embedded Linux development, secure firmware, and technical consulting. You will play an essential role in supporting our clients as they develop, update, and secure their embedded systems, particularly in response to evolving security standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities in Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

  • Design, develop, and optimize embedded Linux software for various hardware platforms.

  • Work closely with our skilled engineers and customers.

Desirable: Additional Responsibilities

  • Collaborate on hardware root-of-trust, secure boot, and chain-of-trust implementations.

  • Assist in system hardening, configuration for security, encryption, and access control mechanisms and embedded patch management.

What We’re Looking For: Skills & Experience in Embedded Linux.

  • Background in software development and embedded systems, specifically with Linux.

  • Ability to work with Linux both in user and kernel space.

  • Experience working with Yocto

  • Structured, analytical, and reliable approach to problem solving.

  • Excellent English communication and writing skills, able to convey technical detail concisely and clearly.

Desirable: Additional Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, software lifecycle management, or security architecture (from any industry – embedded, medical, IT, defense, etc.).

  • Experience working with security standards – e.g. IEC 62443-4-1/2, IEC 81001-5-1, ETSI EN 303 645, EN 18031, ISO 27001.

  • Hands-on experience with secure software development technologies such as secure bootloaders, encrypted data storage, threat modelling (e.g. STRIDE), and system authentication methods.

Why Join Prevas? Career Growth in Embedded Linux & Consulting

  • Be part of a dynamic team where you work closely with experts who value problem solving, personal growth, and technical passion.

  • Opportunities to influence product security strategies in real-world projects.

  • Work with a great mix of industries and customers – from large corporations to dynamic startups.

  • Create lasting impact in both products and organizations through your consulting work.

About Prevas: Engineering Excellence in Embedded Linux & Electronics

At Prevas, embedded technology is at our core. Over the last 40 years, we have completed more than 5,000 development projects across software and electronics. We see development as a natural part of life – from idea to product, and from career to personal growth. Our open, inclusive atmosphere provides you with the space to be yourself and develop your ideas, while working across disciplines with dedicated colleagues.

If you share our passion for problem-solving, teamwork, and learning, and you want to help shape the future of embedded systems and secure IoT solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Contact Us

For more information or an informal conversation about the role, please contact VP Technology Peter Aagaard Kristensen at +45 51 54 33 66. You can also find out more about us on our website and LinkedIn page.

We look forward to welcoming you to Prevas – where every day is a chance to build something great together.

title: Sales Assistant (Salgssupporter as it is called in Danish)
description:
Risskov Teknik og Solar ApS · Risskov, Aarhus · [Full-time] · English-speaking role

Every commercial solar offer starts as a technical calculation. The technical team builds that calculation; you translate it into an offer. Our Technical Director takes it to the client and closes the deal.

RTS designs and installs solar solutions for Danish homes in the range of 1 kW-30 kW and for Danish companies and public organizations, in the 50 kW–1 MW segment.

What you will do

  • You receive the calculation, price build-up, margin check from the technical team and make a customer offer following our existing systems, tools and templates.

  • The customer offers are then reviewed and approved by our Technical Director, who then sends them to the clients.

  • When we participate in tenders, you support our Technical Director to ensure that our responses and compliance along with the checklists for the project are updated and sent.

  • Under the guidance of our Technical Director, keep customer records, project documentation, offer templates, data sheets and the price library current.

  • Prepare pipeline summaries for sales meetings and the input for lessons learned on closed projects.

  • When required, research for materials, prices and regulatory requirements that a client, a project or our Technical Director wants to investigate about.

  • Support the Technical Director on the day to day: calls, calendar, meeting material, documentation and follow up on supplier deliveries.

What you bring

  • A structured way of working and thinking.

  • Precision with numbers and advanced Word, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

  • Fluent written English. Danish is not required, because client conversations are handled by Danish colleagues.

  • Comfortable working within processes and new tools and systems.

  • No solar sizing experience required.

  • Positive energy and the conviction that a good working place is everyone’s job.

title: Hoist Operators
description:
Expression of interest

Offshore Helicopter Hoist Operators – Supporting the Green Energy Sector

Join Our Hoist Operator Pool for Future Opportunities

At Avincis, we are proud to support the green energy transition by providing safe and efficient helicopter transport to offshore wind farms and associated installations.

As the offshore wind industry continues to grow, we are preparing for potential future expansion of our operations in Denmark and Northern Germany. We are therefore interested in connecting with experienced Hoist Operators who may wish to join our team as new opportunities arise.

---

Please note that this is not an active vacancy. We are building a network of qualified Hoist Operators who may be interested in future opportunities within our operations. Candidates whose qualifications and experience match our requirements may be contacted as suitable positions become available.

  

About the Role

As a Hoist Operator at Avincis Aviation Denmark, you will be part of a professional crew operating Airbus H135/H145 helicopters to support offshore wind operations. You will play a key role in supporting offshore operations. Missions include precision hoisting to offshore turbines, vessels, and substations.

Who we are Looking for

Minimum qualifications:

  • Physically and mentally fit

  • Can pass EASA Class 2 medical

  • English Speaking

  • Must be a safety minded person

  • You enjoy working as a part of a team.

Highly desirable experience:

  • Residence in Denmark or nearby region

  • Scandinavian speaking

  • Experience as a Hoist Operator, or under education as a pilot.

 

Why Join Avincis Aviation Denmark?

  • Be part of a mission-driven company contributing directly to the green energy transition

  • Operate modern aircraft in a well-established and safety-focused organization

  • Work in a dedicated team that values professionalism, adaptability, and collaboration

  • Be part of a strong team spirit in a dynamic and high-performing work environment

 

About Avincis Aviation Denmark

Avincis Aviation Denmark delivers specialized helicopter solutions to the offshore wind sector – a rapidly growing industry at the forefront of the climate challenge. We offer flexible, reliable and safe transport of crews and equipment to wind farms and vessels in among others the North Sea and in the waters around Denmark.

With a track record of operational excellence and close partnerships with key players in the wind industry, we are proud to be part of building a sustainable energy future.

How to Apply

Please upload CV, relevant licenses and certificates.  Danish and English written applications are accepted.

Candidates meeting the qualification requirements may be invited to provide additional documentation regarding aeronautical experience and qualifications.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and retained for consideration in connection with future recruitment processes.

Avincis Aviation Denmark A/S is committed to equal opportunities and evaluates all applications fairly and objectively, regardless of gender or background.

Your data will be handled confidentially in accordance with EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR). For further details, please refer to our privacy policy or contact us at the email above.

Du bliver en del af en ejendomskoncern, der ejer mange flotte og velbeliggende ejendomme i hele Danmark, og du kommer til at repræsentere den service og standard, man kan forvente som lejer i koncernens ejendomme, hvor vi er under konstant udvikling. Læs gerne mere på www.barfoedgroup.dk
