description: At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. And we need people like you to make it happen. Director, Value Streams, Data & Transformation Job summary We are now offering an exciting opportunity to lead PSE’s enterprise backbone across value streams, business processes, tools, data, AI-enabled productivity and transformation delivery. In this role, you will enable the business to scale through clear ownership, strong cross-functional integration and consistent execution. What you will do As Director, Value Streams, Data & Transformation, you will:     Own the target design and architecture for PSE value streams and the business process architecture across relevant end-to-end flows.     Define and govern the processes, tools and capabilities required for plant engineering from sales through handover, covering process, packaging, functional, electrical and automation engineering.     Standardise and scale relevant processes across I2M, L2C and P2F, including the corresponding value-stream processes.     Provide business governance for tools, priorities and requirements, and coordinate major process, tool and data implementations across functions.     Own the master data strategy and governance model, ensuring high-quality installed-base data and reusable design content.     Define and drive AI-enabled productivity use cases, adoption and the related roadmap.     Lead cross-PSE transformation programmes and establish an effective transformation management cadence.     Ensure that process and tool changes are anchored in measurable business value and delivered through integrated roadmaps and implementation plans. Who you are We believe that you have:     Senior leadership experience in enterprise transformation, business architecture, process excellence, data governance or a comparable field.     A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems or another relevant discipline.     A strong enterprise-architecture mindset, with the ability to connect strategy, value streams, processes, systems and data.     Demonstrated capability to lead complex, cross-functional transformation programmes in an engineering or industrial environment.     The ability to translate business priorities into governance, roadmaps, requirements and measurable outcomes.     Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across business, technology and operational functions in a multicultural setting.     A strategic, outcome-oriented and self-directed leadership approach, together with excellent command of English, both written and spoken. We offer you     A highly influential role with the opportunity to shape PSE’s enterprise backbone and transformation agenda.     A variety of exciting challenges with opportunities for development and learning in a truly global landscape.     A culture that pioneers innovation, where industry experts collaborate to deliver visible results.     An equal-opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion.     Market-competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements. Apply now! If you are inspired to share our responsibility of protecting food to protecting the planet, please submit your CV in English at HR.Res.Admin.Sweden@tetrapak.comThis job posting expires on November 08, 2026.

title: Solutions Consultant (App Engagement) to leading search engine comapany

title: Customs Compliance Specialist
description: Company DescriptionCustoms Operations Europe and Africa region in Älmhult, Sweden consists of approximately 47 co-workers. The department includes a dedicated team of Customs Compliance Specialists, alongside operational customs teams, working together to secure well-functioning import and export processes for more than 30 countries in the region. We provide daily support and coordination on customs-related topics, including legal requirements, goods flow, and IT solutions, to secure availability, affordability, and compliance.Job DescriptionThe Customs Compliance Specialist ensures the efficiency and compliance of the import and export activities in their region and for the countries assigned to their region.You will:· In conjunction with the Customs Compliance Manager, establish and maintain Compliance procedures and working methods associated with areas of responsibility· Lead and coordinate customs classification activities within the assigned area of responsibility, ensuring accurate tariff classification, compliance, and alignment with business needs.· Manage and support customs compliance programs including post-entry corrections, free trade agreements, bonded solutions and other customs special procedures.· Lead or support customs compliance reviews, internal assessments and external customs audits.· Support the establishment and maintenance of customs compliance controls, risk mitigation activities and corrective action plans.· Build strategic relationships with internal and external business partners, including Customs or other Government agencies· Work with Finance, Accounting, Transport and Purchasing partners on compliance issues· Maintain regulatory knowledge and analysis skills as business, regulations or systems change to meet business needs· Support business expansion and customs-related projects by securing customs compliance readiness and operational implementation.QualificationsWe are now looking for a new colleague who wants to be a part of our amazing team. We believe you are motivated and inspired by the above assignments. You have plenty of energy and curiosity to learn, and we see that you are a person that is driven and dares to challenge people around you. You are service-minded, with a clear and respectful way of communicating. You enjoy working in a structured way both on your own, within the team and with relevant stakeholders. You have high integrity and the ability to establish relationships at all levels ofthe organization, based on trust. You can work with both operational and tactical issues, and you possess facilitation and trainer skills. You can prioritize your work to deliver assignments with high quality. You also can analyze the details while keeping focus on the big picture and follow up on relevant goals and deviations.You should be:· Comfortable with working and navigating in digital IT solutions· Fluent in English, both written and verbalWe believe that you have:· Demonstrated knowledge of Customs Import/Export regulations and compliance management· Strong knowledge and practical experience in customs valuation, rules of origin, Free Trade Agreements, customs special procedures, compliance controls, and customs audits and investigations, with the ability to identify risks, ensure compliance, and support business objectives.· Solid knowledge and practical experience in customs classification (tariff classification) and related processes, including the application of customs regulations and maintenance of classification data.· Experience and knowledge of Change Management· Good listening skills and strong ability to document and communicate in a clear way· Ability to build efficiency and compliance into operations while meeting the business needs· Previous experience in working with external authoritiesAdditional InformationPlease note this position is based in Älmhult, Sweden. For this position we expect that you will work the majority of your time from the office.We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence  requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group. If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Sandra Obers, Customs and Compliance Manager for Europe and Africa via sandra.obers1@inter.ikea.com. If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact Samuel Karlsson via samuel.karlsson@inter.ikea.com.Please apply in English before the 26th of November, 2026. As we are eager to fill this position, interviews may be conducted before the application deadline. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

title: Electronics Engineer to Hardware Department at Westermo

You want to work hands on with electrical design, and you appreciate working together with colleagues from different parts of the organisation.You work well independently while also valuing collaboration and knowledge sharing. As a person, you are proactive, curious, and motivated by delivering high-quality solutions together with others.Requirements    Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or similar    Experience in electronics hardware design    Fluent in English, both written and spoken    Proficient in Swedish, both written and spokenMeritorious    Experience developing industrial products or products used in demanding environments    Experience in design for manufacturing (DFM) and design for test (DFT)    Experience working closely with productionIn return, we offer:You will be working at the forefront of technology in a friendly, open culture where we you get the opportunity to learn from skilled colleagues every day. title: Souschef
description: På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av den natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt större arrangemang. Inspirationen hämtas från stadens tre kulturer den svenska, samiska och tornedalsfinska och genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Camp Ripans kök är ett av Sveriges mest klimatsmarta kök, där vi arbetar med modern teknik och hållbara arbetssätt för att minimera vår påverkan på miljön.Nu söker vi en engagerad och driven souschef som vill bli en viktig del av vårt kök och samtidigt njuta av en storslagen fjällvärld med norrsken, midnattssol och fantastiska fritidsmöjligheter.Som souschef har du en central roll i den dagliga driften av köket och ansvarar för att servicen flyter på med hög kvalitet, struktur och ett gott samarbete mellan kök och servering. Du leder genom att vara en förebild, stöttar och motiverar dina kollegor och bidrar till en positiv, respektfull och lösningsorienterad arbetsmiljö.I rollen ingår även att säkerställa kvalitet, struktur och hygien i köket samt planera mise en place, lager och beställningar. Tillsammans med kökschefen arbetar du med kostnader, matsvinn och menyutveckling. Du är en viktig länk mellan kök, kökschef och servering, löser problem som uppstår under service och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både teamet och verksamheten.Vi söker dig som har ett stort intresse för matlagning och yrket, trivs i ett högt tempo och tycker om att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Du har minst sex års erfarenhet inom restaurang, gärna med tre års utbildning och tre års arbetslivserfarenhet från à la carte-restaurang. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll, har god kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och/eller engelska och trivs med att ta ansvar. Som person är du engagerad, prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att skapa riktigt bra mat och få ett team att fungera tillsammans.Tjänsten är på 100 % och är en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetstiderna varierar utifrån verksamhetens behov och innebär arbete på både vardagar och helger. Personalboende finns att tillgå vid behov.Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten. Välkommen med din ansökan! At Camp Ripan, you have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region so special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service and mutual respect are fundamental.At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our restaurant, where we serve breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as larger events and gatherings. Our culinary inspiration comes from Kiruna’s three cultures Swedish, Sámi and Tornedalian which are reflected throughout our entire operation. Camp Ripan’s kitchen is one of Sweden’s most climate-conscious kitchens, where we use modern technology and sustainable practices to minimise our environmental impact.We are now looking for an engaged and driven Sous Chef who wants to become an important part of our kitchen team while enjoying the spectacular mountain environment, with the Northern Lights, Midnight Sun and fantastic outdoor activities right on your doorstep.As Sous Chef, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the kitchen and be responsible for ensuring that service runs smoothly, with high quality, structure and strong cooperation between the kitchen and other departments. You lead by example, support and motivate your colleagues, and contribute to a positive, respectful and solution-oriented working environment.Your responsibilities will also include ensuring quality, structure and food safety in the kitchen, as well as planning mise en place, monitoring stock levels and handling orders. Together with the Head Chef, you will work with food and labour costs, food waste and menu development. You will be an important link between the kitchen, Head Chef and service, solving problems that arise during service and actively contributing to the development of both the team and the operation.We are looking for someone with a genuine passion for cooking and the profession, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working as part of a team. You have at least six years of experience in the restaurant industry, preferably including three years of culinary education and three years of professional experience in an à la carte restaurant. You are confident in your professional role, have good communication skills in Swedish and/or English, and enjoy taking responsibility. As a person, you are committed, humble and solution-oriented, with a genuine motivation to create great food and help a team perform at its best.This is a full-time, permanent position (100%). Working hours vary according to the needs of the business and include both weekdays and weekends. Staff accommodation is available if needed.Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once we have found the right candidate.We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Junior ASIC Backend Engineer
description: Join our team as an ASIC Backend Engineer!Are you passionate about advanced ASIC development and eager to work at the forefront of technology? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your contributions truly matter? We are looking for candidates to expand our dynamic ASIC Backend team in Lund to help shape the future of our ARTPEC SoC chips.Learn more; https://newsroom.axis.com/article/artpec-foundation-qualityYour future teamThe ASIC System team is at the heart of developing the next generations of ARTPEC SoC chips. We are responsible for the SoC architecture and the ASIC implementation phase, playing a crucial role in both ongoing projects and future innovations. Our team consists of Project Managers, ASIC SoC System Architects and ASIC Back-End Engineers. We work closely with our ASIC vendor, internal RTL design and verification teams, and key stakeholders to ensure our SoC designs meet the highest standards.We are a highly skilled and motivated team with a mix of junior and senior members. Our strength lies in our individual expertise and our collaborative, open working environment.The team designs and implements the SoCs used in Axis products including security features that give our products a high level of trust in IoT ecosystems and enables interoperability with major IoT security standards.For this we are now looking for candidates that want to join our ASIC Backend team.What you will do as ASIC Backend EngineerAs an ASIC Backend Engineer, you will work with a broad range of tasks such as floor-planning, synthesis, equivalence checking, power integrity and timing closure. Our team has a key role in the implementation phase where we bring all new functionality into working silicon. This is done in close collaboration with the RTL design team as well as the ASIC vendor throughout all phases of the project.The ASIC Backend Engineer plays an important role in the ASIC project and has a large impact on the performance and quality of the ARTPEC chips. You will be part of a team that have the expert knowledge of all implementation details and design checks required to get an optimal chip out of advanced ASIC technology nodes. We use state-of-the-art tools and design flows and are continuously improving our way of working to be ready for the next round of design complexity and technology challenges.We are now looking for a junior ASIC Backend Engineer to strengthen our team. Some typical areas that you will participate in as ASIC Backend Engineer are:· Top level floorplan and power planning· Subsystem partitioning and macro placement· Block and subsystem physical synthesis· Low power implementation· Top level I/O timing constraints development· Timing optimizations and timing closure· Static and dynamic IR-drop analysis· Equivalence checking· Evaluation of new tools and technologiesWho are we looking for/Who are you?We are looking for highly motivated engineers who want to make a difference. Suitable background would be a bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, engineering physics or similar. We are looking for a junior engineers and hope you will bring qualities like:· Knowledge of ASIC technologies and low-power implementation flows· Experience from EDA tools used for floor-planning, synthesis and timing closure· Experience from writing SDC based timing constraints for STA and for driving implementation tools· Experience from UPF based low-power implementation flows· Programming and scripting skills in C, Python, TCL and similar languages· Good presentation and communication skills in EnglishAs a person we believe you are analytical and systematic. You enjoy sharing your knowledge and ideas with both senior and junior team members. You are curious and eager to learn new areas to improve yourself, our team and our way of working. As teamwork is crucial for Axis it is important that you contribute to a good team spirit by promoting a creative and stimulating work environment.At start you will be provided with a mentor that will help you during the onboarding program and accelerate your ramp-up, personal development and guide you through Axis giving you a foundation for a great network within the company What Axis Has to OfferWe are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:Life at Axis blogEngineering at Axis blogInnovation at AxisReady to Act?Do you want to join us? Apply today! Contact our recruiting ASIC Systems Manager Tomas Larsson on phone +46 46 272 1500 if you want more information.

title: Business Controller*in
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Business Controller*in---Business Controller\*in=======================DauerstelleStadtspital ZürichFür das Strategische Controlling im Departement Finanzen suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit.### Aufgaben* In dieser spannenden Funktion innerhalb des Strategischen Controllings bist du Mitglied des Teams Planung und Steuerung.  * Kernaufgabe dieser Abteilung ist die finanzielle Steuerung der Business Einheiten sowie die Sicherstellung der Kosten\- und Ergebnistransparenz und die Erarbeitung von Massnahmen zur Verbesserung der finanziellen Situation.  * Du unterstützt die operativen Führungskräfte in den medizinischen Bereichen als Sparringpartner. Weiter berätst du die Kliniken in der Strategischen Entwicklung. Darüber hinaus arbeitest du eng mit dem Medizincontrolling und der Betriebsbuchhaltung zusammen.  * Du erstellst aussagekräftige Analysen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnungen und arbeitest an der jährlichen Budgeterstellung mit.  * Du nimmst eine aktive ein bei der Weiterentwicklung der Controlling\-Instrumente und Reporting\-Tools.  * Du arbeitest mit und/oder leitest Projekte bei betriebswirtschaftlichen und fachübergreifenden Themen (Einführung Centerrechnung, Ambulante Tarife, etc.).  ### Profil* Hochschulabschluss in Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung  * Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Controlling  * Analytisches und konzeptionelles Denkvermögen  * Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Darstellung und Vermittlung komplexer Zusammenhänge  * Ziel\- und Ergebnisorientierung  * Initiative Persönlichkeit mit Durchsetzungsvermögen und hoher Eigenverantwortung  * Du bist es gewohnt stufengerecht zu kommunizieren und verstehst dich als Teamplayer  * Hohe IT\-Affinität und Erfahrung im Umgang mit SAP sowie BI Systemen runden dein Profil ab  * Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen und branchenspezifisches Wissen der Daten\- und Wertströme nach REKOLE sind von Vorteil  ### Wir bietenWir bieten dir mehr als nur einen ! Unsere Stadtspital\-Welt ist geprägt von einer offenen Du\-Kultur, einem unkomplizierten, persönlichen Miteinander und der nötigen Prise Humor im Alltag. Als Team aus über 120 Berufsgruppen setzen wir uns täglich auf ganz unterschiedliche für das Wohl unserer Patient\*innen ein. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen, flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen einschliesslich Homeoffice und ausgezeichneten Sozialleistungen der Stadt Zürich.### Über unsDas Stadtspital Zürich zählt mit über 36'000 stationären und rund 455'000 ambulanten Patient\*innen pro Jahr zu den Top 10 der Schweizer Spitäler. Als modernes Zentrumsspital an mehreren Standorten in der Stadt Zürich bieten wir die gesamte Bandbreite der medizinischen Grundversorgung, inklusive 24\-Stunden\-Notfall und Intensivmedizin an. Unsere 4'500 Mitarbeitenden setzen sich täglich mit viel Engagement und Herzblut für eine exzellente Patientenversorgung ein.### Interessiert?Für weitere Informationen steht dir , Teamleiterin Planung und Steuerung, Telefon , gerne zur Verfügung.Referenz\-Nr.: 52022******jid81b072ajm jit1044jm jiy26jm

Ownership of relationship process (from initiation to closure).SkillsMasters degree with a background in Finance preferableCertified Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or Master of Business Administration (MBA) is desirable  Fluency in English is a prerequisite & Arabic is an advantageAt least 5-8 years industry experience covering Saudi and/or Egyptian  UHNW clientsExcellent communication and collaboration skillsClient-oriented, solution-oriented and able to work in a high paced environment under pressureSuperior investment acumen and solid network of clients in the target coverage market is requiredGood understanding of Governing Regulatory FrameworkStrong Collaboration skills and excellent communication skills with a positive approachProfessional integrityAbility to manage resources and allocate them for most effective useWilling and able to develop other staffWell-being & BenefitsEmotionally and mentally balanced: We support you in maintaining good mental health. Benefit from initiatives such as training events, counseling and support in difficult life situations and a culture where you can openly speak about mental health. Reach out to our Employee Assistance Programme or Mental Health First Aiders (MHFA).Physically thriving: We support you managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive. We offer online yoga classes, standing desks, and promote healthier ways of working via LearningHUB and wellbeing initiatives.Socially connected: We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being. Are you looking for a varied role where you can take ownership, work closely with different teams and contribute to a meaningful mission?**To strengthen our Shared Services team, we are looking for an experienced and proactive Manager Finance and Controlling 100%------------------------------------ In this role, you will be responsible for finance and controlling across Basel Area Business \& Innovation and the Switzerland Innovation Basel Area AG. As part of a small, collaborative team, you combine financial expertise with a practical, hands\-on approach, ensuring reliable financial management and supporting informed decisions across the organisation.  You work closely with management and business units and provide professional guidance to an Associate Manager Administration and Accounting, who handles day\-to\-day accounting and administrative activities and supports you across the finance function. This is a varied role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, working independently and getting things done.  ### Key responsibilities* **Finance \& Accounting:** Ensure reliable financial accounting for both organisations and actively prepare and coordinate annual financial statements and audits in collaboration with internal and external partners.* **Financial Planning \& Controlling:** Prepare and coordinate budgets, forecasts and financial plans, monitor financial performance and provide regular reports and analyses to management and business units.* **Business Partnering:** Act as a Controlling:** Monitor project budgets, funding agreements and financial KPIs, identify deviations and follow up on necessary measures.* **Contract \& Legal Coordination:** Manage and coordinate key Maintain and improve financial processes, internal controls and reporting structures, working closely with colleagues and external partners. ### Your profile* Education in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field, ideally complemented by a relevant professional qualification.* Several years of practical experience in finance, accounting and controlling, including hands\-on experience with annual financial statements under Swiss accounting standards.* Solid knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting and analysis, with the ability to independently prepare and work with financial information.* A structured, analytical and reliable working style, combined with a pragmatic, hands\-on and solution\-oriented mindset.* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues from different professional backgrounds.* Very good knowledge of financial systems and Excel; experience with Abacus is an advantage.* Fluency in and English; French is an advantage.* Experience in contract management, project\-based or publicly funded organisations is a plus.Above all, you enjoy working in a small organisation where responsibilities are broad, collaboration is close and everyone contributes hands\-on.### What you can expect* varied and responsible role with broad exposure to different business areas and close collaboration with management.* The opportunity to contribute your expertise, shape financial processes and make a direct impact in a purpose\-driven, non\-profit organisation.* A small, supportive and collaborative team where people work together and take a practical approach to getting things done.* An international and interdisciplinary working environment connected to the Basel Area innovation ecosystem.* Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work remotely for part of your working time.### Interested?We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about you.**Workload:** 100%  **Location:** Basel, Switzerland  **Start date:** As soon as possible or by agreement  *Please note that our recruitment process is managed using Bloomie, our title: Information Security Director

Reporting to the VP of IT, this role combines strategic leadership with operational execution across cybersecurity governance, risk management, cloud security, identity management, compliance, and incident response. The successful candidate will play a critical role in protecting the organization's digital assets, supporting business growth, and ensuring a robust security posture within a highly regulated environment.* Develop, implement, and continuously enhance the company's cybersecurity strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.* Lead cybersecurity governance, risk management, and compliance programs, including policy development, risk assessments, internal controls, and audit readiness.* Own the security architecture across cloud, infrastructure, applications, endpoints, and collaboration platforms, with a strong focus on Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments.* Oversee identity and access management (IAM) processes, ensuring secure user provisioning, privileged access controls, and authentication standards.* Direct security operations, including threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation activities in collaboration with internal and external partners.* Manage cybersecurity third\-party service providers, including MSSPs, security consultants, penetration testing firms, and technology vendors.* Lead business continuity, disaster recovery, and cyber resilience initiatives to ensure operational preparedness and rapid recovery capabilities.* Establish and monitor cybersecurity KPIs and metrics, providing regular executive\-level reporting and recommendations to leadership.* Drive data protection, privacy, and information security initiatives, ensuring appropriate safeguards for critical business and research data.* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-related risks and controls, to ensure secure adoption and governance.* Promote a strong cybersecurity culture through awareness programs, employee education, and stakeholder engagement across the organization.**Profile*** Bachelor's or master's degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity and IT, including at least 3\-5 years in a leadership or management role.* Proven track record of developing and executing enterprise cybersecurity programs within complex and highly regulated environments.* Strong expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, security operations, incident response, and vulnerability management.* Hands\-on experience securing Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, endpoint protection platforms, and cloud\-based infrastructures.* Deep understanding of identity and access management, 0\-trust principles, network security, and modern cybersecurity architectures.* Experience leading security audits, regulatory assessments, and compliance initiatives aligned with frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, or similar standards.* Previous experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, medical device, or other regulated industries is highly desirable.* Demonstrated ability to communicate technical and cyber risk topics to executive leadership, board members, and non\-technical stakeholders.* Strong project management and vendor management capabilities, with experience leading cross\-functional initiatives.* Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CRISC, or Microsoft Security certifications are highly valued.* Excellent leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decision\-making across all levels of the organization.**Job Offer*** Attractive package and environment* Flexibility with 2 days of Home Office per week* A unique opportunity to build, lead, and shape a growing cybersecurity function within an innovative and international organization.* Ownership of high\-impact cybersecurity, compliance, and digital transformation initiatives.* A collaborative and dynamic work environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional development.* Exposure to cutting\-edge technologies, cloud environments, and evolving cybersecurity challenges.* Competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and attractive long\-term career growth opportunities.jpida216b3fjm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

title: Security Analyst / Architect
description: Ref 2588110 \| Date: 29 Oct 2026![Bechtle Suisse SA]( )Security Analyst / Architect (f/m/d)Be your best with Bechtle-------------------------Avec plus de 16 000 employés, nous sommes l'une des entreprises informatiques les plus prospères et les leaders du marché dans notre secteur.  L'association de la vente directe de produits informatiques et d'une gamme complète de prestations de services proposée par les différentes sociétés de services informatiques fait de nous un partenaire informatique fort et porteur d'avenir (« zukunftsstark ») pour les entreprises moyennes, les grands groupes et le secteur public. Nous sommes chez nous dans toute l'Europe et toujours près de chez vous.  Security Analyst / Architect (f/m/d)====================================Be your best with bechtle-------------------------Pour le compte de notre client basé à Genève, nous recherchons un·e Security Analyst / Architect (f/m/d) pour une mission de 6 mois, chargé d'assurer les opérations de sécurité, de garantir la continuité des services critiques et d'accompagner la sécurisation des déploiements GenAI et du Product Lifecycle Framework.#### **Ta mission*** Piloter la gestion des vulnérabilités de bout en bout : scans mensuels, analyse et priorisation des CVE selon CISA KEV et EPSS, suivi des correctifs et reporting de conformité, tout en assurant la migration de Rapid7 InsightVM vers CrowdStrike Vulnerability Management.* Exploiter et faire évoluer l'environnement CrowdStrike : migration du tenant européen, retrait de Cortex XDR, intégration des sources de logs dans Next\-Gen SIEM, développement de règles de détection et traitement de niveau 2 des alertes et incidents.* Assurer la sécurité réseau et le cycle de vie des certificats en appliquant les hardening releases Fortinet et Palo Alto, en révisant les règles de pare\-feu et en pilotant les activités TLS/PKI, notamment inventaire, renouvellements, DCV et audit de la PKI interne.* Piloter les remédiations issues des tests d'intrusion et Red Team, prendre en charge les sujets de sécurité en backlog, notamment les guardrails AWS et SCP, et devenir autonome sous trois mois sur les services de sécurité critiques afin d'en assurer la continuité.* Sécuriser les déploiements GenAI et leur intégration au cycle de vie produit en réalisant les threat models, en définissant les guardrails avant mise en production et en intégrant les contrôles de sécurité aux différentes étapes du Product Lifecycle Framework.Ton profil----------* Minimum 5 ans d'expérience pratique en security engineering ou security operations, dont au moins 2 ans dans un environnement d'entreprise complexe, avec une forte autonomie sur des services de sécurité opérationnels.* Expérience confirmée de la gestion des vulnérabilités de bout en bout : scanning, Fachspezialist:in Rechnungswesen, 80\-100%
==========================================

HEKS beschäftigt über 1500 fest angestellte Mitarbeiter:innen. An 24 Standorten in der Schweiz und weltweit in 35 Ländern ist HEKS mit 290 Programmen und Projekten im Umfang von rund 144 Millionen Franken tätig. Im Jahr 2024 erreichte HEKS rund 16 Millionen Menschen mit seiner Arbeit.  

HEKS verfolgt die Vision einer gerechten Welt, in welcher die Würde aller Menschen respektiert wird, Frieden herrscht und die natürlichen Lebensgrundlagen bewahrt werden. Ziel ist eine Transformation auf sozialer, wirtschaftlicher und politischer Ebene. HEKS leistet einen Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Lebensumstände von Menschen in der Schweiz und weltweit, fordert ihre Rechte ein und sensibilisiert und mobilisiert zu diesem Zweck.  


Wir verstärken unser Finanzteam in Zürich und suchen nach Vereinbarung eine:n

Fachspezialist:in Rechnungswesen, 80\-100%
------------------------------------------

### Das sind deine Hauptaufgaben:

* Du trägst im Tagesgeschäft die Verantwortung für das Führen des Hauptbuches nach den Vorgaben von Swiss GAAP FER und dem schweizerischen Obligationenrecht, insbesondere\- Bearbeitung und Verbuchung von Abgrenzungen, Bewertungsfragen, Rückstellungen und weiteren komplexen Einzelsachverhalten\- Sicherstellen der korrekten und vollständigen Abbildung aller Nebenbücher (Kreditoren, Spendenbuchhaltung, Anlagebuchhaltung etc.)\- Führen der Anlagebuchhaltung
* Du wirkst proaktiv an Weiterentwicklungs\- und Digitalisierungsprojekten innerhalb der Finanzbuchhaltung mit
* Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstellung der periodischen MWST\-Abrechnungen in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld (Pauschalsteuersatzmethode, internationaler Kontext) sowie für die Beurteilung und Deklaration der Bezugssteuer und die Abrechnung und Rückforderung der Verrechnungssteuer
* Du wirkst als Fachspezialist mit im Konsolidierungs\-, Kreditoren\- und Ertragserfassungsprozess, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Kolleg:innen im In\- und Ausland
* Du unterstützt das Team bei Fragen rund um die Abwicklung von Legaten, bei der Planung und Durchführung der externen Revision, sowie beim Sicherstellen eines effektiven internen Kontrollsystems


### Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

* Eine kaufmännische Grundbildung sowie ein abgeschlossener oder laufender Fachausweis im Finanz\- und Rechnungswesen oder eine vergleichbare Zusatzausbildung sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion
* Fliessende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt, Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
* Vertiefte MWST\-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Business Central sowie Kenntnisse in der Buchhalterischen Behandlung von Fremdwährungsthemen sind von Vorteil
* Eine engagierte, dynamische und strukturierte Persönlichkeit mit Zahlenflair
* Affinität für Prozessautomatisierung und digitale Tools


### Das darfst du von uns erwarten:

* Eine sinnstiftende, vielseitige und spannende Tätigkeit in einer renommierten NGO mit nationaler und internationaler Ausrichtung
* Hohe Selbständigkeit und die Möglichkeit zur Mitgestaltung in einem Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
* Grosse Flexibilität bezüglich Präsenzzeiten und Arbeitsort
* Zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen

Collaborateur / technicien SAV \- Machines à café \& Matériel de fête
=========================================================================

**Collaborateur / Technicien SAV – Machines à café \& Matériel de fête**

**Lieu de travail :** Chavannes\-les\-Forts  
**Taux d'activité :** 100%  
**Entrée en fonction :** de suite ou dès le

**À propos de nous :**  
Nano Coffee Sàrl est un acteur clé de la région dans la fourniture, la location et l'entretien de machines à café professionnelles et de matériel événementiel. Pour renforcer notre équipe technique et garantir un service d'excellence à nos clients (entreprises, fêtes), nous recherchons un collaborateur SAV polyvalent et passionné.

**Vos missions principales :**

**Suivi clients \& relevés mensuels :** Effectuer les visites mensuelles auprès de nos entreprises partenaires pour réaliser les relevés de compteurs des machines à café et évaluer l’état général des fourniture.

**Maintenance et réparation :** Assurer le diagnostic, l'entretien préventif et le dépannage (en atelier et chez les clients) de machines à café de différentes marques ainsi que du matériel de fête (friteuses, grills, etc.)

**Préparation et logistique :** Contrôler et tester le matériel de fête avant chaque mise à disposition et au retour des locations pour garantir leur parfait fonctionnement

**Service client \& urgences :** Conseiller les clients sur l'utilisation du matériel et intervenir rapidement en cas de panne, notamment lors d'événements durant la saison haute

**Gestion administrative :** Rédiger les rapports d'intervention

 

**Votre profil :**

Formation technique (CFC d'électromécanicien, électricien, mécanicien sur appareils ou formation jugée équivalente)

Expérience confirmée dans le dépannage (une expérience sur les machines à café est un sérieux atout)

Permis de conduire de catégorie B obligatoire

Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’organisation

Flexibilité dans les horaires (disponibilité pour des piquets le week\-end en période de fêtes)

Maîtrise du français (oral et écrit).

 

**Ce que nous offrons :**

Une activité variée au sein d’une petite entreprise familiale

Travail dans des locaux entièrement rénovés

description: Company DescriptionSyngenta Group, a global leader in agricultural technology and innovation, employs 60,000 people across more than 100 countries to transform agriculture through tailor-made solutions for farmers, society, and our planet. Our diverse portfolio encompasses seeds, crop protection, nutrition products, agronomic solutions, and digital services, all designed to help farmers produce healthy food, feed, fiber, and fuel while conserving natural resources and protecting the environment. Our mission is to address critical challenges such as climate change and food security through sustainable practices and cutting-edge solutions, while safeguarding the planet's resources. At our R&D Center in Stein AG, Switzerland, the Crop Protection Research (CPR) Chemistry team is at the forefront of innovation. Here, you will design and synthesize novel products that promote crop health and contribute to the evolution of agricultural practices. Your work will play a crucial role in advancing our mission to ensure global food security through sustainable solutions. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.Job DescriptionYour responsibilities:Lead and contribute to research projects, applying state-of-the-art research programs to identify and optimize novel bioactive ingredients interacting with relevant biological targets for crop protection.Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams with local and global experts to drive research programs to develop sustainable crop protection solutions.Advance project delivery through scientific investigations, applying expertise in molecular design, physical organic chemistry, and synthetic problem-solving.Formulate and experimentally test data-driven hypotheses, deconvolute complex structure–activity relationships (SAR) by integrating empirical and predictive data to drive Multi-Parameter Optimization toward key project milestonesDrive scientific advancement and technological innovation in modern agrochemical discovery by proactively developing and applying cutting-edge skills and technologies, while fostering a culture of continuous learning, creativity, and strategic foresight.Embed digital, data, and AI capabilities into project workflows to accelerate discovery and improve predictive decision-making.QualificationsWhat we are looking for:Scientific Foundation: Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry or Medicinal Chemistry; postdoctoral or industry experience is an advantage.Technical Expertise: Deep expertise in synthetic organic chemistry; direct application to bioactive small molecule research is strongly preferred and highly valued.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership: Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated success in steering multidisciplinary scientific teams, driving consensus, and delivering project milestones across complex matrix environments.Innovation Mindset: Self-driven and curious, with a proactive approach to adopting emerging technologies and advancing project goals.Communication: Excellent command of English, adept at conveying complex scientific findings to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.What you bring to our team:Technical curiosity for life sciences, including small molecules and new chemical modalities.Enthusiasm for applying and championing cutting-edge science and digital technologies.Creativity, curiosity, and strong decision-making skills with a commitment to continuous learning.Excellent organizational and time management abilitiesCollaborative mindset with strong communication skills to build productive relationships within Syngenta and with international collaboratorsDedication to welcoming different perspectives and fostering a diverse, inclusive and open work environmentAdditional informationWe provide access to state-of-the-art research facilities and technologies, enabling you to apply and expand your expertise in agrochemical design principles, synthetic organic chemistry, and active ingredient optimization.We cultivate a superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce, where new ideas are always welcome. We embrace flexible work arrangements and foster work-life balance.We foster a digitally enhanced research environment throughout our R&D processes. This offers you the opportunity to develop digital data analysis skills, positioning you at the forefront of drug discovery.We invest in your professional growth and development through a multidisciplinary training program tailored to foster a rewarding career in crop protection.We are part of a strong regional Science hub, offering you the opportunity to interact with a rich community of scientists in life sciences, further enhancing your professional network and knowledge exchange.You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance…)Are you interested? Please send your complete application with CV in English, diploma and work certificates (if applicable).Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )--- Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )====================================================================================================================**SCHOOL PROFILE**The International School Basel (ISB) is an English\-language international day school for students from ages 3 to 18\. ISB is home to approximately 1,110 students who enjoy modern purpose\-built facilities on three campuses clustered a few kilometers south of Basel in the towns of Reinach and Aesch. ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. Due to work permit restrictions, preference will be given to candidates of EU/Swiss nationalities and candidates who hold a current Swiss work permit. Kindly note that the School reserves the right to end the search early should a suitable candidate be identified. **WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!**![International School of the Basel Region AG]()* International School of the Basel Region AG  Fleischbachstrasse 2  4153 Reinach BL*jid3be8078jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

fund governance framework.The role combines leadership, fund operations expertise, regulatory oversight and hands\-on process optimisation. **Key Responsibilities*** Lead, mentor and develop a small figures* Oversee the production of investor disclosure documents and regulatory fund reporting* Act as the primary counterpart to external fund administrators regarding NAV oversight, NAV reconciliations and exception management* Participate in fund valuation activities and contribute to valuation\-related decisions and governance processes* Coordinate annual and semi\-annual reporting processes, including collaboration with auditors, tax advisors and external stakeholders* Review fund\-related invoices, operating expenses and service provider charges* Oversee the preparation and quality assurance of factsheets, management reports and client reporting* Identify opportunities to automate operational processes, improve data quality and increase efficiency across the fund title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  The Department of Process Engineering (ENG) has a vacancy for a  Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.  This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in Sumo, which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design.  We are looking for a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. The preferred starting date is September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\.  At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and /.  Applications can be submitted until the position is filled and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.  For further information, please contact Mengqi Zhu or Dr Derlon.  We look forward to receiving your application. Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.  Apply now  Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology jpid92ba563jm jit0731jm jiy26jm
